requirement.description: The VHttpSrv class is missing the uparam_cc_ok attribute initialization. Tests fail with AttributeError when accessing conn.hsrv.uparam_cc_ok because this attribute is not defined in the test mock classes, but is used in the real HttpSrv class and httpcli.py.
requirement.contract: The VHttpSrv class (and its subclass VHttpSrvUp2k) must initialize the uparam_cc_ok attribute as a set containing "doc move tree" strings, matching the initialization in the real HttpSrv class (line 192 in httpsrv.py).

requirement.description: The Metrics class does not produce the cpp_active_dl metric which is expected by the test. The test expects this metric to be present with value 0 in the metrics output.
